items.statement: CarepathRx has one clearly dated, citable AI/automation initiative in the sources gathered: in a Feb. 9, 2026 case study, CarepathRx and Centric Consulting said they deployed a hyperautomation workflow combining RPA, OCR, Python, and AWS Bedrock/Claude to extract data from hospital discharge notes and unstructured medical records, achieving near-100% accuracy and reducing document processing cost to about $0.04 per document.

citations.title: Using AI to Capture Unstructured Medical Records Data
